summary: Core TypeScript code solid: proper type annotations, error handling, glob pattern logic. Workflow YAML follows standards (pinned refs, minimal permissions, structured env). Workflow is basic CI setup, not the complex validation pipeline specified. Custom glob-to-regex increases maintenance vs. library. Deliverable incomplete.
